2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Bo Nix and Patrick Mahomes return to put the AFC West opener on quarterback execution
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: Denver and Kansas City open the season with both quarterbacks returning from significant late-season injuries: Bo Nix from an ankle issue and Patrick Mahomes from the knee injury that ended his previous campaign. That makes pocket movement and protection especially important early. The Broncos need Nix operating on time without asking him to manufacture every answer, while the Chiefs can test Denver’s discipline by extending possessions and forcing the visitors to defend Mahomes after the initial structure breaks down.
2026_01_DEN_KC.model_rationale: Quarterback movement and protection will shape the opener, with Denver needing clean timing and Kansas City trying to create the off-script situations Mahomes handles best.
